defs.def: a person or an organization that buys sth from a shop/store or business 顾客；主顾；客户

ex.s: The spacious dining room is regularly filled with customers enjoying dumplings and a variety of noodle and rice dishes.
ex.t: 宽敞的餐厅里经常坐满享用饺子以及各种面食和米饭菜肴的顾客。

ex.s: Customers can also place pickup orders online for lunch or dinner until 8:00 pm six days a week.
ex.t: 顾客也可以在线下单自取午餐或晚餐，每周六天营业至晚上8点。

ex.s: Catherine Murphy, a cafe worker in a green shirt and black hat, makes sure that each customer gets exactly what they order.
ex.t: Catherine Murphy是一名穿着绿衬衫、戴黑帽子的咖啡馆员工，她确保每位顾客都得到自己点的东西。

ex.s: Doing a survey of customers.
ex.t: 对顾客做调查。

ex.s: If most of their customers are happy to buy larger quantities, that’s   59   they’ll promote.
ex.t: 如果他们的大多数客户都乐意购买更大数量，那就是他们会推广的__59__。

ex.s: Not all the customers are tourists.
ex.t: 并非所有顾客都是游客。

ex.s: All customers travelling on TransLink services must be in possession of a valid ticket before boarding.
ex.t: 所有乘坐TransLink服务的顾客在登机前必须持有有效的车票。

ex.s: Customers using mobility devices
ex.t: 使用移动设备的顾客

ex.s: As s businesswoman, I care deeply about my customers.
ex.t: 作为生意人，我深深关心我的顾客。

ex.s: I remember the first really   48   customer we had at Covent Garden.
ex.t: 我记得我们在Covent Garden遇到的第一个真正   48  的顾客。

ex.s: If a customer is rude or difficult, just think "Maybe she’s had a row with her husband.
ex.t: 如果顾客粗鲁或难缠，就想想“也许她刚和丈夫吵了一架”。

ex.s: This can be useful for businesses such as restaurants and stores because it offers a new way to attract customers.
ex.t: 聚光灯只照亮舞台的一个部分；同样，"定向声音"在目标区域创建一个圆形的声音区域。

ex.s: Restaurants can offer a choice of music along with the various food choices on the menu, allowing customers more control over the atmosphere in which they are dining.
ex.t: 餐厅可以在菜单上各种食物选择之外提供音乐选择，让顾客更多地掌控用餐氛围。

ex.s: strict control over any suspicious customer
ex.t: * 严格控制任何可疑客户;

ex.s: And it's all supported by an efficient customer service team, available through telephone, email and online chat.
ex.t: 这一切都由一个高效的客服团队支持，可通过电话、电子邮件和在线聊天联系。

ex.s: If you aren't satisfied, just write to Customer Service within 21 days.
ex.t: 如果你不满意，只需在21天内写信给客服部门。

ex.s: Shop assistant and customer.
ex.t: 店员和顾客。

ex.s: He interviews customers at the bar.
ex.t: 他在酒吧采访顾客。

ex.s: provide better services to customers
ex.t: 54    有时即使是常规事件也会成为愤怒前或愤怒本身的来源。

ex.s: Mrs Stanley was one of my customers.
ex.t: 斯坦利太太是我的客户之一。

ex.s: You ask your customer whether he/she needs a doggie bag.
ex.t: 你询问顾客是否需要打包袋。

ex.s: The customers must have got up very early.
ex.t: 顾客们一定起得很早。

ex.s: You want to persuade a customer to buy a new mixed fruit drink.
ex.t: 你想说服顾客购买一种新的混合果汁饮料。

ex.s: Customers can get 20% off if they buy five bottles or more at a time.
ex.t: 顾客一次购买五瓶或以上可享八折优惠。

ex.s: You’re right,… I'm afraid… Well,… Student B You are a customer.
ex.t: 你说得对，……恐怕……嗯，…… 学生B 你是一位顾客。
